description: Exploit, building on E007's finding that time scales with pixel count. On the E007 recipe at 9 epochs, use a more aggressive resolution schedule: the first 30% of steps at 20 px, then 30% at 24 px, 20% at 28 px, and the last 20% at 32 px. Each resolution is compiled and warmed up in build with channels_last synthetic batches of the exact training shape. Use error_on_recompile after build. Keep the global max-pool head so the network works at every size.
